name: Dai's Creative Creations

reviewSamples.author: Massiel
reviewSamples.text: I've used this vendor for 10 years, the Dominican-style flavors are amazing. Delicious cakes and amazing service!

reviewSamples.author: Nabilla
reviewSamples.text: Pure excellence. The cake was beautiful, delicious, and enjoyed by everyone.

reviewSamples.author: Walkiris
reviewSamples.text: Never disappointed! Consistently on point, and I love the Dominican cakes.

reviewSamples.author: Carmen
reviewSamples.text: Awesomeness overall, loved the Dominican cake and appetizers. A customer for life.

reviewSamples.author: Cindy
reviewSamples.text: Best Dominican cake that you will ever have!!! Quality, presentation, and taste were all excellent.

reviewSamples.author: La Wonder
reviewSamples.text: Very professional, great tasting cakes, always brings to life the design you want.

notes: Sin Instagram/Facebook publico verificado (confirmado en discovery y por WeddingWire, que tampoco lista redes para este vendedor). Direccion, telefono, rating, reseñas y precios (buttercream desde $7/porcion, fondant desde $10/porcion, cupcakes desde $3 c/u, consulta y degustacion privada incluidas) verificados en el perfil publico de WeddingWire (vendor 130173), que coincide con la direccion y telefono del discovery. Nombre de la dueña (Dahiana) y antigüedad del negocio tambien tomados del perfil de WeddingWire. 8 fotos reales descargadas de la galeria publica de WeddingWire para este vendedor (verificadas una por una, sin marca de agua de terceros ni selfies ni capturas de pantalla).
